LAUNCHER: TBRT01/design/TBRT01_PREREGISTRATION.md — self-issued, authorised by the owner on 2026-08-27: 's'il faut douze heures, go pour les douze heures'.
THE_QUESTION: after the parent's influence is removed, AND in the presence of a matched competing Y source it could wrongly absorb, does an organisation issued from the daughter retain an ancestry of its own?

ARM_DEFINITIONS.SELECTIVE: the parent's Y is removed through the engine's decay channel, Y -> WY; the OMLDCT02 treatment, kept for comparability
ARM_DEFINITIONS.DISPLACED: the parent's Y is removed from its cells and the SAME mass is placed at the toroidal antipode of the DAUGHTER's centroid, at Chebyshev >= 2 from every daughter cell

DISPLACEMENT_IS_MORE_INVASIVE_THAN_REMOV: removal uses the engine's own decay channel. Displacement is a teleport: no engine channel moves mass across the lattice in one step. Two things bound it and both are verified on real engine objects in TBRT01_FIXTURES.json — total Y mass is conserved exactly, and no random number is consumed.
THE_REFUTATION_CONDITION_FROZEN_BEFORE_A: if the CERTAIN set of the daughter's lineage ever absorbs a descendant of the displaced mass, Model C is REFUTED. One absorption suffices. No threshold, no magnitude judgement, checkable by enumeration.
CEILING_IS_NOT_A_STOPPING_RULE: the campaign stops on TARGET_VALID_TRIPLES. The ceiling is a cost bound. If it binds, that is a failure of the design and is recorded as one.
HOW_THE_CEILING_WAS_SIZED: EVCS01's corrected instrument, on OMLDCT02's PROSPECTIVE 805-seed ledger, with the admissible rate drawn from its own Jeffreys posterior rather than held at the point estimate. 926 is the 95th percentile for 41 triples. A rate-known calculation would have said 821 and attained about 85 per cent — the error EVCS01 found in its own instrument and fixed. The TLMR01 developmental rate 22/256 is NOT used and is marked DO_NOT_SIZE_FROM_THIS.
THIRD_ARM_COSTS: +6 per cent per admissible triple, 15.47 to 16.39 arm-instances, because 87 per cent of the budget goes on seeds that never trigger and that no arm touches.

THE_FREEZE_WAS_REGENERATED_ONCE_BEFORE_A.why: after the first freeze was written, tbrt01_run.py was changed to shard across two workers on disjoint index residues, which halves the wall clock and touches no rule. That changed METHODS_HASH, so the freeze was regenerated and C2 was amended in place.
THE_FREEZE_WAS_REGENERATED_ONCE_BEFORE_A.why_this_is_not_a_violation: no scientific-scale world had run. A freeze regenerated before execution is a freeze being finished; a freeze regenerated after execution would be fatal, and the guard enforces exactly that by refusing when the working-tree freeze differs from the committed one.
THE_FREEZE_WAS_REGENERATED_ONCE_BEFORE_A.what_sharding_does_not_change: the target, the ceiling, the stopping rule, the seed order, the arms, the refutation condition, or any per-seed result. Each seed is independent and is claimed by exactly one worker by index residue.

WHAT_WOULD_INVALIDATE_TBRT01: a scientific-scale world before this freeze is committed
a seed reused from any earlier manifest
the refutation condition modified after the first world
a destination inside the daughter's one-step reach
